meta.title: Day {day} of {days}: Outer Zones Close, the Stairwell Opens
meta.summary: Floor 1 timed playthrough, Day {day} of {days}: the outer zones (Z0 to Z4 plus 3b) close, the stairwell opens about 32 hours in, and each Crawler may choose to descend early into stasis. Three routes, three encounters, key availability, early-descent handling, last-chance hooks and a stall fallback. CR, budget, credit and loot figures are cited from rules/70-encounter-budget-5e.json by field path (GM-adaptable guideline). Collapse notices use Lore's draft wording; the final collapse is fixed and a missed collapse is death on every floor, with no Reprieve.

clock.short_rest_note: A CAP, not a promise; the GM may end a day early.
clock.day_ends: At the party's saferoom Long Rest, or at 24 in-game hours if they have not had one (the System rolls the day over anyway). The last day is different: the floor collapses at 24 in-game hours into Day {days} no matter what.
clock.lights_out: Stays inside each day as a hazard: every 8 hours the Pit goes dark for 1 hour; outside saferooms the overview's Ceiling Ticks roll applies (00-overview.md section 2 rule 6, section 5.11).
clock.authority: decisions/026-timed-floor-clock-override.md (Caleb; Syndicate confirmations of ~9:25, ~9:35 and ~9:45 PM CT; Caleb rulings of ~10:00 PM CT (Floor 3 = 20 days) and ~10:02 PM CT (a missed collapse is death on every floor)). Overrides the old 'Floor clock: off' wording. The fixed final-collapse hour is a Syndicate default Caleb may veto. 00-overview.md section 2 rule 6 matches these rulings.
clock.canon_note: Canon books have ONE collapse at timer end. The stepwise collapse below is a HOUSE mechanic, tagged inspired.

collapse_order.event: The Break Room (Z6) and vendors lose service; the Break Room is no longer a saferoom.
Only the stairwell corridor stays; the floor collapses at 24 in-game hours of this day.

clock.closed_zone_rule: Closed zones lose their loot and achievement hooks and the System announces it with a snarky notice (Lore's wording on the day pages). Zone 9 (The Green Room) saferoom stays open to the end (house exception, inspired).

clock.zone_groups: Confirmed (decision 026, tagged inspired): outer zones (Z0 to Z4 plus 3b) close Day 2; mid zones (Z5, Z7 and Z8) close Day 3; on Day 4 the Break Room (Z6) and vendors lose service; on Day 5 only the corridor (Z10, Z11 and Z S) remains. The Z9 Green Room saferoom stays open to the end (inspired). Closed means hooks and services vanish; the route (Z6, Z8, Z9, Z10, Z11) is never cut.
clock.stairwell_opens: About 32 hours after the floor opens, early Day 2 (canon M-276, VERIFIED). The Z10 boss arena also holds a stairwell (canon M-275). The Stairwell key and the Zone S door are house ideas, tagged inspired.
clock.early_descent: A Crawler who descends with more than {stasis_hours} hours left on the floor is held in stasis until the floor collapses (canon M-277, VERIFIED): this banks the achievement and ends that Crawler's floor. In the last {stasis_hours} hours, descent is free. Each Crawler chooses for themselves; the GM may override with a logged reason.
clock.collapse_order_status: confirmed per decision 026; the steps only remove hooks and services, and the Detour Tax is the only toll on the clock (a missed Stairwell key only)

final_collapse.status: Syndicate default, decision 026; Caleb may veto
final_collapse.text: The final collapse comes at a FIXED moment: 24 in-game hours into Day {days} (hour {floor_hours} of the floor). A Long Rest never ends the floor and never skips it; the System cuts short any rest that would run past the collapse.

collapse_miss.tag: canon-aligned (canon: a missed collapse ends the run)
collapse_miss.text: Any Crawler not at a stairwell when the floor collapses is dead, and all Crawlers still on the floor die with it. There is no Reprieve, no toll and no detour for it. Death rules follow Core section 6 (death is pretty much game over). Per decision 028 (tagged inspired): the dead Crawler's credits and items are destroyed with the floor; surviving party members may loot the body only while the floor still stands, and anything taken before the collapse is theirs. NPCs and the AI go into stasis and lose nothing.
collapse_miss.stasis_counts: Early-descent stasis (canon M-277) counts as reaching a stairwell.
collapse_miss.detour_tax_scope: The Detour Tax now covers only a missed Stairwell key, never a missed collapse.

saferoom_rule.text: The Break Room (Z6) is a saferoom through Day 3 and stops being one when it loses service on Day 4 (Syndicate ruling, decision 026). From then on the Z9 Green Room is the only saferoom, open to the end of the floor (tagged inspired).

clock.achievement_caps: Floor caps still apply: the soft cap is 2 to 3 achievement boxes per Crawler per floor (Caleb's ruling); on Floors 1 and 2 the Silver ceiling and one Story Box per floor hold. Rewards are tailored by the GM and snark-only is allowed; the proposed achievements are a seed list at GM discretion.

rest_fee_note.text: GM ruling: no fee if the spot is already quiet. A Short Rest in a place that is already quiet is free; the fee only buys quiet where the area is not (for example the dark halls on Days 4 and 5).

canon_table.note: Lore's Floor 1 canon table. Tags: canon / inspired / unverified. Each encounter cites its zone id, tag, confidence and ledger rows; the script copies them from the table at build time.

day.start_note: Default start is the Green Room, where the Day 1 Long Rest should have ended. If the day rolled over elsewhere, start there.
day.collapse_today: Outer zones (Z0 to Z4 plus 3b) close: hooks and services there vanish; the route is not cut. The stairwell also opens early today. Tagged inspired.

tomorrow_notice.text: FLOOR NOTICE. Tomorrow the middle of the building closes: the bait stairs, the locker room, the shooting gallery. Anything you meant to take, take today.

rest_options.note: Honest saferoom and open to the end of the floor (inspired). Short Rests and the Long Rest that closes the day.
Honest saferoom through Day 3; it stops being a saferoom when it loses service on Day 4 (decision 026).

A field rest can only be a Short Rest (Core section 5.6: Long Rests only in saferooms). The rest-without-a-saferoom price ({{b70:floors.1.prices.rest_without_saferoom}}) buys a quiet Short Rest and grants no Long Rest; unpaid or noisy, Ceiling Ticks interrupt it (00-overview.md section 2 rule 7). A saferoom is where the day's Long Rest happens (the Break Room through Day 3, the Green Room always). GM ruling: no fee if the spot is already quiet. A Short Rest in a place that is already quiet is free; the fee only buys quiet where the area is not (for example the dark halls on Days 4 and 5).

The GM checks the sheets and ledger for what is already claimed; Encounter Bot does not read state.

day.stall_fallback: Day 2 is the first day the clock bites. If the party stalls in the Green Room, the speaker posts the next-collapse countdown, the stage doors stay open, the Lights-Out hour arrives on schedule, and a Long Rest ends the day. Do not steer anyone toward early descent; it is each Crawler's choice. A party that wants to wait for the last six hours of the last day may do so; the cost is the clock and the collapses in between. A Crawler who is not at a stairwell when the floor collapses is dead, with no Reprieve (decision 026); keep the warning in view.

collapse_notice.text: Attention, Crawlers: the outer zones are now closed for renovation, and by "renovation" we mean "gone." Anything you left in them is now a lesson. The way forward remains open. You're welcome.

stairwell_opening.text: ATTENTION, CRAWLERS: the stairwell is open, the real one, behind the stage. Go down early and you sit in stasis until the floor falls, because management doesn't hand out head starts. Go down late and you get to walk. Choose like adults.

player_prompt.text: STAIRWELL NOTICE: go down now and you sit in stasis until the floor collapses, keeping the achievement and losing the rest of the floor. Each of you decides for yourself, and nobody can decide for you. The System won't judge anyone who waits. It will judge a few other things.

early_descent.gm_override_note: The GM may override a Crawler's choice only with a logged reason (decision 026, Syndicate ruling). Never push a Crawler toward early descent; the choice is theirs. A Crawler in stasis has finished the floor; their sheet and boxes follow the Floor 2 arrival rules (00-overview.md section 7.3).

early_descent.sideline_note: A Crawler in stasis is out of the floor, not out of the game. Their player gets short sideline System scenes until the party arrives on Floor 2: waiting-room gags, and a vote on the party's next move. The GM decides how much weight the vote carries, keeps each scene brief, and cuts back to the main table. (Syndicate ruling, decision 026.)

missing_key_cost.text: Missing the key is a COST, not an instant wipe: a detour (back to Z8 or Z6 while those still serve), the Detour Tax toll, or the loud keyless forcing. Missing the collapse is a different matter: it is death (see the missed-collapse rule).

stairwell_key.fake_stairwell: The Big Green EXIT at Z7 is bait, not a stairwell (00-overview.md section 5.7). Taking it costs time and a fall.

lines.text: A section of ceiling lets go behind you, and the noise rolls down the corridor like applause. The speakers crackle: "Zone closing. Please enjoy your last look."
The floor tiles ahead are bright and clean. The ones behind are gray rubble. Someone has painted a thin white line where the two meet, and it is moving toward you.
A vending alcove sits half-buried under fallen concrete, its light still blinking. The sign reads "Temporarily closed. Permanently, actually."
Dust hangs in the air and every footstep leaves a print. Somewhere a mob is following the prints, and it is patient.

proposed_achievements.name: Early Withdrawal
proposed_achievements.tag: proposed by Encounter Bot, framed by Lore, reward = slot for Syndicate
proposed_achievements.narration: You left early. The floor is still here. So are you, in a closet.

canon_ref.use: Parallel canon: 'The Early Bird Gets To Squirm'.

quick_run.setup: A concrete stairwell behind the stage with a card taped to the rail.
quick_run.decision: Each Crawler chooses alone: descend now into stasis, or wait for the free descent?
quick_run.on_success: Every Crawler has chosen and the table knows who is where.
quick_run.on_failure: A Crawler is pushed to choose; the GM must log a reason or decline.
quick_run.cut_short: Read the prompt once to the whole table and take four quick answers.

changes.effect: That Crawler banks the achievement and their floor is over; they sit in stasis with short sideline System scenes until the party arrives, and they take no part in later encounters.
A waiting Crawler keeps playing every day, takes the Dean fight or a bypass, and descends freely in the last six hours.

changes.choice: A GM override of someone's choice
changes.effect: An override needs a logged reason; the other Crawlers notice and the System comments on it.

gm_tracks: Floor hour: running count of hours since the floor started and hours into today, against the fixed final collapse at 24 in-game hours into Day {days} (floor hour {floor_hours}). A day that ran short or long shifts where the collapse falls on the floor clock (overview section 2 rule 6).
Per Crawler: waiting or in stasis (and when)
Any override logged, with the reason
Sideline scenes run for stasis players
